name: NOAA H11876 2 m MLLW grid near Pacific Beach and La Jolla

spatial.horizontal_crs: WGS 84 / UTM zone 11N (original BAG compound CRS)

temporal.update_cadence: Historical survey; monthly original-source and chart review

evidence.supports: Original NOAA catalog page links the H11876 survey archive and exact BAG.
Original report describes survey dates, generalized charted rocky-seabed areas and historical chart discrepancies.
Independent dated USGS camera-observation metadata; source ZIP was hash-pinned and cross-screened with the BAG.

limitations: The WGS84 bounds are the transformed rectangular raster envelope, not its valid-data footprint or a fishing area. The original native-cell mask must be used.
The 2011 USGS observations form eleven qualifying rocky windows on just two correlated camera transects. They do not define reef edges, current fish presence or a catch rate.
No exact hard-bottom polygon, full current-chart and route screen, or date/method-specific local fishing clearance has been approved. Keep this source out of fishing targets, scores and exports.
The exact archive redistribution terms have not been reviewed for republication; retain the raw original in the private source cache.

producer.name: NOAA National Ocean Service, Office of Coast Survey

provenance.access_service: NOAA NCEI original-file archive; USGS Data Series 781 camera archive
transformations: Original 2 m BAG opened; native elevation and product-uncertainty cells screened at original camera positions.
Raster extent transformed to WGS84 for catalog discovery; nodata retained and envelope not promoted as coverage.
Two historical USGS camera transects joined to the exact BAG; separate bounded ENC danger, charted seabed-point and CDFW MPA receipts recorded in h11876-la-jolla-camera-chart-review.json.
